## Installation

You can install package minifunctions from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("EduardoJacob/minifunctions")
```

## Package Overview

**minifunctions** is an R package containing ~35 standalone utility functions across these domains:
- Number Theory (continued fractions, digital roots, Euclid numbers, multiplicative order)
- Combinatorics (derangements, permutations, powersets)
- Algebra (polynomial fitting, parabola analysis, Newton-Raphson root finding)
- Base conversions (decimal/fractional bases)
- Data visualization (HTML table rendering, image grids)
- RStudio integration utilities

---

  Example Functions:

  Continued Fraction Utilities

  - continuedfraction() (R/continuedfraction.R) - Generates continued fraction vector for input number
  - continuedfractioninverse() (R/continuedfractioninverse.R) - Converts continued fraction vector back to number

  Decimal & Fraction Conversions

  - decimalfixed() (R/decimalfixed.R) - Computes exact fraction from fixed decimal
  - decimalrepeating() (R/decimalrepeating.R) - Converts repeating decimal string (e.g., "1.8[3]") to fraction
  - decimalrepeatinginverse() (R/decimalrepeatinginverse.R) - Converts fraction to repeating decimal string

  Combinatorics & Set Theory

  - derangement() (R/derangement.R) - Recursive count of derangements for set size n
  - derangements() (R/derangements.R) - Generates all derangements as dataframe
  - permutations() (R/permutations.R) - Returns unique permutations of length L from vector
  - powerset() (R/powerset.R) - Generates power set (all subsets) as list of vectors

  Number Theory & Arithmetic

  - digitalroot() (R/digitalroot.R) - Recursively computes digital root by summing digits
  - euclidnumbers() (R/euclidnumbers.R) - Calculates nth Euclid Number (product of first n primes + 1)
  - multiplicativeorder() (R/multiplicativeorder.R) - Finds smallest k where a^k ≡ 1 mod n
  - highprecision() (R/highprecision.R) - Performs arithmetic with 256-bit precision via Rmpfr/gmp
  - repunit() (R/repunit.R) - Generates repunit string of '1's repeated n times

  Base Conversions

  - numberconvertion() (R/numberconversion.R) - Converts integer between base systems (e.g., 10→16)
  - numberconversionfrac() (R/numberconversionfrac.R) - Converts to fractional base representation
  - numberoperation() (R/numberoperation.R) - Performs arithmetic in non-decimal base

  Algebra & Numerical Methods

  - getfunctionpolynom() (R/getfunctionpolynom.R) - Computes polynomial through (X,Y) coordinates
  - newtonmethod() (R/newtonmethod.R) - Newton-Raphson root approximation for function f
  - parabola() (R/parabola.R) - Solves parabola properties from standard form (ax²+bx+c)
  - parabolafromfocus() (R/parabolafromfocus.R) - Derives parabola from focus and directrix

  Data Visualization & Utility

  - printdataframe() (R/printdataframe.R) - Renders dataframe as styled HTML table
  - truthtable() (R/truthtable.R) - Generates truth table for logical function
  - minmax() (R/minmax.R) - Min-Max normalization (0–1 range) on numeric columns
  - shufflein() (R/shufflein.R) - "In" shuffle simulation (perfect riffle)
  - shuffleout() (R/shuffleout.R) - "Out" shuffle simulation (perfect riffle)
  - getmonths() (R/getmonths.R) - Returns 12 month abbreviations in current locale
  
  Image Utilities

  - imagegrid() (R/imagegrid.R) - Displays folder images as grid using magick
  - imagerenamer() (R/imagerenamer.R) - Mass rename and fix image extensions

  RStudio Integration

  - editvariable() (R/editvariable.R) - Opens string variable in external editor for editing
